fixture_contract.ownership: Outer owns the unreaped foreground anchor/session leader. Separate same-session manager starts CLI in the anchored foreground group. Only direct owners signal separately grouped descendants. AnchorGuard cleans manager before killing its self-owned foreground group.
fixture_contract.test_only_dependency: /bin/ps observes stopped state of the owned, unreaped anchor, with1s execution and128-byte output checks. No Node is required by native integration. CLI SIGTSTP uses manager waitpid, not ps.
fixture_contract.unsupported_combination: Portable fixture does not guarantee both helpers simultaneously stopped/unresponsive can be fully cleaned. It returns bounded failure and avoids stale-PID/group signaling; this is a test-fixture limitation, not a native runtime regression.
fixture_contract.discard_boundary: No input is sent while echo is deliberately restored during suspension. TCIFLUSH concerns unread kernel input; already-read editor content survives. No claim of atomic flush/restore or protection for typing after cancellation.
